intro.text: Glowing fish that swim in shoals through the endless dark.
Invested fish that swim in shoals through the unsea of the emberdark, keeping clear of bigger creatures such as the skullsnakes that hunt them.

description.text: Those able to sense the waves of the unsea can pick out their shoals.

items.text: Lost in the endless dark, Dusk spotted shoals of glowing fish and hoped the way they moved might show him where islands lay.
